description: 同一件事，换一个位置或时间来看，意思完全不同
core_questions: 如果从另一端看，这件事是什么样的？
谁是这个场景里被忽略的那一方？
这件事在它结束之后，才能被看清吗？
bad_output_patterns: only describes what is seen from one angle
states that perspective matters without showing it
good_output_patterns: shows the same thing meaning two different things at once
reveals what is visible only from a different position
turns an assumed fact into a question by shifting viewpoint
changes how the reader understands the relationship between observer and observed
